name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-jsom-modern-compatibility
title: JSOM Modern Compatibility
shortDescription: Generates ready-to-copy JSOM scripts for classic and modern SharePoint pages with automatic dependency loading and site-relative SharePoint library resolution.
longDescription: Generates ready-to-copy JSOM scripts that end users can paste directly into the browser developer console on SharePoint pages without manually handling dependency loading.

Supports classic SharePoint pages, modern SharePoint pages, and SharePoint 2013 classic pages. Ensures core SharePoint JavaScript libraries such as SP.js, SP.Search.js, SP.Taxonomy.js, and SP.UserProfiles.js are loaded before business logic runs.
Uses the current site URL as the base for loading SharePoint JavaScript dependencies so subsites and site collections resolve libraries correctly instead of falling back to the tenant root site.
Optimized for end users by returning one complete JavaScript code block, concise console logging, short run instructions, and a safety warning for destructive operations.
